openBlockers.detail: Canon source segmentation is certified independently of v1.83 card archaeology. The remaining reader-structure task is to integrate source-first LIVE navigation across the full Mass and certify it on phone; exact recovery of historical C01-C48 is not required.

Asperges and Palm have source-pinned native payloads plus modular-runtime traversal contracts. Production native-preview mounting remains pending for both. Ashes, Candlemas, Rogations, Requiem/following actions, Good Friday and Easter Vigil still require native payload/rendering.
Real-browser phone-width/touch acceptance for focus, first/last cue ownership, Back/Next, translations and card transitions has not yet been recreated for R17.

MC-COM-150 and MC-COM-160 are now independently suppressible and Pax Domini remains distinct, but MC-COM-160 still carries B/C_PENDING evidence. Accepted source authority and reader ownership for the Solemn ministerial Pax transfer must be pinned before release certification.
